movelist.name: Supersonic
movelist.effect: The target becomes Confused. On miss, the target suffers a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls for one full round.

movelist.name: Thunder Shock
movelist.effect: Thunder Shock Paralyzes the target on 17+.

movelist.name: Thunder Wave
movelist.effect: Thunder Wave Paralyzes the target. Targets immune to Electric Attacks are immune to Thunder Wave’s effects.

movelist.name: Sonic Boom
movelist.effect: Sonic Boom causes the target to lose 15 Hit Points. Sonic Boom is Special and interacts with other moves and effects as such ( Special Evasion may be applied to avoid it, Mirror Coat can reflect it, etc. )

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Moves with the Execute Keyword. If a single source of Damage or Hit Point Loss would cause the user to lose more than X Hit Points, the damage or Hit Point loss is instead reduced to X. X is equal to 50% of their Max Hit Points. Defensive.

abilities.name: Magnet Pull
abilities.effect: Pick Two Effects; - The target is pushed or pulled X meters directly away or towards the user. X is up to 6 meters minus the target’s Weight Class. - Until the end of the user’s next turn, the target may not move more then 6 meters away from the user . - Until the end of the user’s next turn, the target may not move closer than 3 meters ot the user.
